source_review.notes: Checked all twelve references for author or issuing body, title, publication venue, date, revision, and relevant scope. Primary or author records support Coda disconnected operation, Bayou application-specific conflict handling, epidemic anti-entropy, CRDT convergence conditions, local-first principles, and Quicksand. The publisher confirms DDIA edition 2 dated February 2026. Official current records confirm final NIST SP 800-124 Rev. 2 (May 2023), RFC 9562 (May 2024) obsoleting RFC 4122, RFC 3339 updated by RFC 9557 (April 2024), and current SQLite isolation and WAL guidance. Current status and implementation claims were checked 2026-09-06; no source is represented as certification or production proof.

Checked set, tuple, component-wise order, concurrency, summation, derivative, rate, byte, and time units and GitHub math delimiters for consistent rendering.
notation_and_syntax.notes: The offline tuple organizes obligations and is not a numeric maturity or certification score.

evidence: Recomputed the inspection raw bound as 40 inspections/hour times 30,000 bytes times 72 hours = 86,400,000 bytes = 86.4 MB in decimal units.
Recomputed reconnect drain as 2,880/(80-20) = 48 hours and Exercise 3 as 360/(20-12) = 45 hours; confirmed no finite drain when effective service 10 MB/hour is below production 12 MB/hour.
Executed classify-offline-operation under CPython 3.14.4 and matched all six exact outcomes, final remaining rights of 3, empty stderr, and exit status zero.

evidence: Re-derived t_d=b_0/(mu-lambda) from db/dt=lambda-mu under constant rates and verified the condition mu>lambda.
Verified union on {a,b} and {b,c} is associative, commutative, and idempotent for duplicate and reversed delivery.
Checked component-wise version-vector comparison represents inclusion of summarized causal history while incomparability establishes possible concurrency rather than business conflict.
